stories.title: Trump bestraft führende Medienorganisationen und verbannt sie aus dem Weissen Haus

en.title: Trump punishes leading media organizations and bans them from the White House
en.summary: The U.S. president announced plans to punish CNN, MSNBC, and Politico for their reporting by banning them from the White House. Legal experts contend such action would violate the Constitution.

stories.title: «Arena» zur «Lex UBS» – Eigenkapital: Sicherheit für Steuerzahler oder Gefahr für UBS?

en.title: "Arena" on "Lex UBS" - Equity: Security for taxpayers or danger for UBS?
en.summary: Following debate in the Swiss States Council, uncertainty remains about the final strictness of new regulatory requirements for UBS.

stories.title: Union Berlin bleibt beim Auswärtsspiel gegen Bayern München chancenlos

en.title: Union Berlin remains without chances in away match against Bayern Munich
en.summary: Union Berlin lost 0-7 to Bayern Munich in an away match.

stories.title: Des milliers de personnes manifestent au Kosovo en soutien à l'ex-président Hashim Thaçi

en.title: Thousands of people demonstrate in Kosovo in support of former president Hashim Thaçi
en.summary: Several thousand people gathered in Pristina Friday to protest the conviction of former president Hashim Thaçi to 25 years imprisonment for war crimes.

stories.title: National League am Freitag – Bern bezwingt harmlose Davoser – auch Gottéron mit erstem Sieg

en.title: National League on Friday – Bern defeats harmless Davos – Gottéron also claims first victory
en.summary: Bern won their match against Davos while the defending champion recorded their first victory of the new National League season.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Trumps zweite Amtszeit: Trump entzieht CNN und «Politico» Zugang zum Weissen Haus

en.title: Latest Developments - Trump's Second Term: Trump Revokes CNN and Politico Access to White House
en.summary: Donald Trump is serving his second term as US President with significant domestic and foreign policy consequences. His administration has restricted media outlets' access to the White House.

stories.title: Women's Super League – Keine Tore im ausgeglichenen Spitzenspiel in Genf

en.title: Women's Super League – No Goals in Balanced Top Match in Geneva
en.summary: Servette Chênois and FCZ women ended their top-of-the-table Women's Super League clash in a goalless draw.

stories.title: Les Eglises suisses ont continué de perdre des fidèles en 2025

en.title: Swiss Churches Continued to Lose Members in 2025
en.summary: Switzerland's national churches experienced fewer departures in 2025 than the previous year, yet membership decline persisted in the Catholic and Reformed Evangelical churches. Religious baptisms and marriages also decreased.

stories.title: Röstigraben musical: pourquoi les Romands ne percent pas en Suisse alémanique? (et inversement)

en.title: Musical Röstigraben: why French-speaking Swiss don't break through in German-speaking Switzerland? (and vice versa)
en.summary: Swiss music scenes are divided along linguistic lines, with artists from French and German-speaking regions struggling to gain audiences across the Sarine river. Few Romandy musicians perform in Alemannic Switzerland and rarely the reverse.

stories.title: Actifs de Nestlé saisis «temporairement» en Russie, une première troublante pour la Suisse

en.title: Nestlé assets seized "temporarily" in Russia, a troubling first for Switzerland
en.summary: Russian authorities placed Nestlé's factories under temporary administration of an unknown company following a Kremlin decree. The move marked the first time Switzerland's largest food company faced such seizure since Russia's 2022 Ukraine invasion.

stories.title: En graphiques – Les Eglises suisses continuent de perdre des fidèles

en.title: In charts – Swiss churches continue to lose faithful members
en.summary: Swiss national churches experienced continued membership decline in 2025, though at a slower pace than previously. Religious baptisms and marriages decreased and did not offset departures and deaths.

stories.title: Les actifs de Nestlé en Russie transférés à une société russe, deux sociétés françaises aussi touchées

en.title: Nestlé assets in Russia transferred to Russian company, two French companies also affected
en.summary: Russia transferred Nestlé's assets to a Russian entity under a Kremlin decree, with French retailers Auchan and former Leroy Merlin group facing similar measures. Moscow cited "unfriendly countries" as justification.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Wirtschaft: Volkswagen erwartet für 2026 tiefen Gewinn +++ Bank of Japan erhöht Leitzins auf höchsten Stand seit 31 Jahren

en.title: BRIEF REPORTS - Economy: Volkswagen expects deep profit for 2026 +++ Bank of Japan raises key interest rate to highest level in 31 years
en.summary: Volkswagen forecasts significantly reduced profits in 2026. The Bank of Japan has increased its benchmark interest rate to its highest level in three decades.

stories.title: Glencore suspendiert Mitarbeiter, der die Deals mit dem kontroversen Händler Radiant betreute

en.title: Glencore suspends employee who handled deals with controversial trader Radiant
en.summary: Glencore has suspended an employee responsible for transactions with Radiant, a controversial trader. Multiple Swiss financial and trading firms are affected by the alleged fraud involving the multi-billion-dollar iron ore trade.

stories.title: Putin stellt Nestlés Russland-Geschäft unter Zwangsverwaltung – Bundesbern zeigt sich besorgt

en.title: Putin places Nestlé's Russia business under state administration – Federal Bern expresses concern
en.summary: The Kremlin has placed Nestlé's Russian operations under state control, citing Switzerland's classification as an unfriendly country. Nestlé faces potential expropriation as part of broader Kremlin actions against Western companies remaining in Russia.

stories.title: Nach der Entwendung von Kundendaten fordern Erpresser von Revolut 3 Millionen Dollar

en.title: After theft of customer data, extortionists demand 3 million dollars from Revolut
en.summary: Fraudsters obtained personal information from the neobank Revolut by impersonating Italian law enforcement authorities. Swiss customers are among those affected by the data breach and extortion attempt.

stories.title: Warren Buffett tritt auch als Verwaltungsratspräsident von Berkshire Hathaway zurück

en.title: Warren Buffett Steps Down as Chairman of Berkshire Hathaway
en.summary: Warren Buffett, 96, has relinquished his role as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after stepping down as CEO earlier this year. His son Howard Buffett will assume the chairman position.
